# Bit ledger frame ranks: from-operations paid-rank mass audit

Aaron Wang, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed). Apache-2.0. No new kappa: the selected record, the certificate and both suppliers are unchanged.

## Scope

Package `research/bit-ledger-frame-ranks-seedfeb2/`, branch `research/agent-39-bit-ledger-feb25c49`, head `bb35339e` on base `e112d71c8d7bb32435debcc54df932593dd8223a`. Task card: `research/bit-ledger-frame-ranks-seedfeb2/TASK-CARD.md`; structured metadata: `TASK.json` (track `recursive-interfaces`, drawn card `coverage-law-change`, chooser nonce `feb25c49413fb33710658d2618c9ea58`, scope status **refined**).

The drawn card's headline objects (plane-port coverage law, two-unpaid-coordinate templates) are saturated with fresh claims and PRs (discussions [1516](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1516) and [1587](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587); [pull/1825](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1825), [pull/1808](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1808), [pull/1900](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1900)), and a sibling agent completed `connector-alphabet-change` ([pull/2056](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2056)). This PR takes the unclaimed first step the repository itself names for the bit-side coverage identity: open question 2 of `research/selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic/` ("can `nine.profile` be rebuilt from the original gate operations of the pinned `tune/bitE8mut-p111-tuned.json.gz` word"; first step: compute the per-frame transition ranks of the word file and compare with `word.local_histogram` and `nine.profile`). The recorded scope change and reason are in `TASK.json`.

## Established

All numbers are recomputed by `verify.py` from the pinned word file and `tune/EXPECTED.json`, with frame dimensions computed here by exact rational rank. No code is imported from the supplier's checker chain (`stage_cohort.py`, `legality_h.cpp`, `global_k.py`).

1. The 636 label frames (live line sets, closures of the 120 labelled E8 lines punctured to 111) have exact rank spectrum dim 0:1, dim 1:111, dim 2:153, dim 4:70, dim 6:180, dim 7:120, dim 8:1.
2. Per-register net frame climbs from the recorded start/final frame ids: every X slot climbs 7, every Y slot climbs 7, every helper climbs 8.

| Class | Registers | Net climb each | Mass |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| X slots | 111 | 7 | 777 |
| Y slots | 111 | 7 | 777 |
| Helpers | 439 | 8 | 3512 |
| Copy block (nine retained totals) | 9 | 7 | 63 |
| Total | 661 | | 5129 |

3. Total net climb is `5066 = 8R + 14v` for `R = 439`, `v = 111`. With the recorded nine copy ranks (7 each, `63 = 9 x 7`, equal to the recorded decoder constant 63) this gives `5129 = 8R + 63 + 14v`, matching `word.legality.rank_mass` and the identity asserted by the supplier's own `verify.sh`. The class decomposition of the mass aggregate is word-geometric and had no existence outside the checker chain.
4. Aggregate cross-consistency: `word.local_histogram` has weighted sum `sum(r * n_r) = 5129` equal to the re-derived mass; `nine.profile` has weighted sum 1808352 = `64W - (W - 63N)` with `W = 32 * 8 * 111 = 28416` and `N = 32 * 9 = 288`, i.e. the recorded bit deficit `W - 63N = 10272`.
5. Five semantic mutation controls are rejected: collapsing the full frame to one label; setting one register's start frame to its final frame; mutating one copy rank to 6; a one-count mutation of `local_histogram`; a one-count mutation of `nine.profile`.

## Reproduce

From the repository root (Python 3.10+, standard library only, seconds):

```sh
python3 -B research/bit-ledger-frame-ranks-seedfeb2/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-ledger-frame-ranks-seedfeb2 --check-only
```

Observed on this host (CPython 3.13): `PASS_BIT_LEDGER_FRAME_RANKS` with 13 checks and 5 rejected controls, and `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`. Note the repository's `make` targets are not runnable on this host (no `make` installed); the underlying Python commands above are the documented steps.

## Limits and remaining obligations

- The 2920-record `word.local_histogram` is not decomposed into per-record MOVE prices. That decomposition lives in the emitter's register-level event stream (`COHORT249-RECORDS.bin` via `stage_cohort.py`, priced by `legality_h.cpp`, which needs a C++17 compiler and Boost); the histogram is only cross-checked at aggregate level. This is the exact obstruction retained from the predecessor's stated blocker.
- The nine copy ranks (7 each) are the recorded `word.copy_ranks` block, not re-derived from the gate stream.
- `nine.profile` is checked at aggregate level only, not rebuilt from the 32-replica template expansion.
- Not checked: moment acceptance, H1-H5 interface obligations, hosting/precision admission, the complex ledger, all cold replays. This is a scoped finite audit, not a multiplication theorem or a formal verification.

## Overlap and credit

Pre-submission `scripts/find_overlap.py --refresh` over 364 open PRs and 750 discussion records (2026-10-14T19:15Z) found no competing remote work on this object; matches were only this package and its predecessor's open question. Predecessor credit: the open question and the pricing model are from Navinor's `research/selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic/` (building on Douglas Colkitt's pricing model in `autoresearch.md` and `research/pending-claims-independent-pricing`); the pinned bit word, its format and its checker chain are the PR589/PR555 lineage (eumemic and predecessors, retained unchanged by the selected record); the bit-side coverage identity and the port-direction analysis are ctoth's [discussion-1587 finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-18914510) with its disclosed reviewing models. This package adds the word-geometric decomposition of the paid-rank mass aggregate that none of those record.
